content:
The test image shows soybean pods — one open/split revealing seeds, with prominent round white/cream circular structures visible on the pod interior. The bottom of the main pod shows dark discoloration. These round white circles are characteristic of Soybean Cyst Nematode cysts.

Let me view a reference image to confirm.

The SCN reference showed field-level yellowing symptoms, not matching the test image. 

Analyzing the test image:
- Mature/dried soybean pods, one split open
- Two prominent round white/cream disc-like structures visible inside the open pod
- Dark discoloration concentrated at the base of the main pod
- Pod appears to have split/dehisced abnormally

The round white circular structures visible inside the open pod are seeds, but the pod shows characteristic darkening. The dark discoloration at the pod base and abnormal pod appearance is consistent with **Phomopsis** seed decay, which causes pod discoloration, premature splitting, and shriveled/discolored seeds. The overall dried/brown pod with dark basal lesions fits Phomopsis pod blight.
